Since all time constants in that loop are of the same order of magnitude, they create a system with several poles. As a result, peaking can occur in the current transfer characteristic. An important disadvantage of both current mirrors, is that their minimum output voltage (compliance voltage) is quite high! As a result they cannot be used in low-voltage applications!
